title: Pak, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye agree to deploy forces in Gulf country amid Houthi attacks
summary_full: Pakistan and Turkiye have agreed to provide military support to Saudi Arabia following regional security threats from Houthi rebels. Representatives from the three countries held an emergency meeting to reinforce their Mecca defense agreement. This agreement establishes collective defense provisions that aim for a rapid military deployment if any country is attacked. Additionally, the committee appointed a retired Pakistani General as secretary-general to oversee defense strategies.
